description: Is an A/B test result statistically significant? From visitors and conversions per group: two-proportion z-test (pooled), one or two-sided p-value, Wald confidence interval for the difference, relative lift, Pearson chi-square with and without Yates correction (R prop.test), Fisher exact p for the same 2x2 table, and a sample ratio mismatch (SRM) check against the planned split.

alternative.description: greater = variant converts better than control.

expected_split.description: Planned share of traffic in control, for the SRM check. Default 0.5.
